hooks.command:
bash -c 'cd /Users/natcren/Documents/Projects/_Nasdaq/monorepo || exit 0
ts_files=(); css_files=(); fmt_files=()
while IFS= read -r -d '\'''\'' f; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  case "$f" in
    *.js|*.jsx|*.ts|*.tsx) ts_files+=("$f"); fmt_files+=("$f") ;;
    *.css) css_files+=("$f"); fmt_files+=("$f") ;;
    *.json|*.md|*.yml|*.yaml|*.html) fmt_files+=("$f") ;;
  esac
done < <( { git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR -z HEAD; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z; } | sort -zu )
[ ${#ts_files[@]} -gt 0 ] && pnpm exec eslint --fix "${ts_files[@]}"
[ ${#css_files[@]} -gt 0 ] && pnpm exec stylelint --fix "${css_files[@]}"
[ ${#fmt_files[@]} -gt 0 ] && pnpm exec prettier --write "${fmt_files[@]}"
true'
